label: Contradiction
evidence: the receiving party will, as soon as practicable, either destroy or return all confidential information to the disclosing party ... However, PwC may not retain a copy of the confidential information for our internal purposes.
reason: The receiving party must destroy or return all confidential information, and the only retention clause expressly says PwC may not keep a copy, so the document rules out keeping any confidential information after return or destruction.
